intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hopper Computer Lab, long after dark. One machine is still on. Someone in a long coat is typing very, very fast.

hello.speaker: cpp
hello.text: You. Line 1. 'cout' is not a member of 'std'. How did you even get in here?

teach.speaker: cpp
teach.text: ...Sit down. The compiler is telling you exactly what's wrong. Read it, then fix it.

passed.speaker: cpp
passed.text: It compiles. Don't look so proud, it's one line. ...I'm Ciel. Close the door on your way out.

failed.speaker: cpp
failed.text: Still broken. Read the error again.
